title: Complaints, feedback and duty of candour
summary: How people raise concerns, how quickly and openly the service answers, and whether it says sorry and learns when things go wrong.
whenToUse: Every quarter, after a complaint is upheld, or when feedback or survey results drop.

statements.focus: Complaints log: response times, outcomes and whether people were happy with the answer.
People know how to complain, in a format they can use.
Duty of candour: notifiable safety incidents, apology letters and the records kept.
Staff feel able to raise concerns and know the whistleblowing route.
Themes from complaints and compliments shared with staff and turned into changes.
Managers review complaints and feedback regularly and track the actions.
